[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]], [[Sheep|Other Games]] |produces = Wool}} '''Sheep''' are barn animals available in [[Harvest Moon: DS]] and it's [[Harvest Moon DS: Cute|Cute Version]]. They typically live for about 6 in-game years ==Care== Sheep live in the Barn once it's built. They need to be given fodder (bought at [[Yodel Farm (DS)|Yodel Farm]] for 20 G) daily but adults can graze on Grass that's bought for 500 G at [[Karen (DS)|Karen's]] telephone store. Grass grows in Spring, Summer and Fall but hibernates during winter. To raise it's affection a sheep may be brushed and pet daily (with or without the touch glove). When given a special potion at Yodel farm (for 3000 G), the Sheep with a full coat can become pregnant and give birth in 21 days. The baby then needs 14 days to grow into an adult. ==Products== Sheep produce wool after eight days that can be cut with clippers bought at the Saibara Shop. If you use the touch glove you can get more wool from shearing the sheep. {|border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="width:450px;" ! style="width:30%; background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112); text-align:center;"|Item ! style="width:30%; background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112); text-align:center;"|Value |- |Small Wool |100G |- |Medium Wool |400G |- |Large Wool |500G |} Once you have a Yarn Maker in the Maker Shed, you can turn wool into yarn by putting it into the maker.
